name: dw
description: The dw database stores academic term data (term code, description, start/end dates, current flag, academic year, registration dates, status) in ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER, ACADEMIC_TERMS, and ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL; building information (building number, name, address, gross/assignable square footage) in BUILDINGS; CIP classification details (program code, title, category, four‑digit code) in CIP and CIP_WITH_VERSION; course catalog entries (subject code, title, units, grade type, attributes, instructor counts, term offering flags) in CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and DRUPAL_COURSE_CATALOG; HASS attribute definitions (code, description, icon) in CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE; employee directory records (MIT ID, full name, employee group/type, office, email, title, department) in DRUPAL_EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY and EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY; estimated surcharge financials (cost collector, GL account, amount, budget figures, record type) in ESTIMATED_SURCHARGES_ESTONLY; facility building and room data (building number, name, acquisition/occupancy dates, area, type, location, cost center, address, floor, room, major/minor use, organization, coordinates, access level) across FAC_BUILDING, FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS, FAC_FLOOR, FAC_MAJOR_USE, FAC_ORGANIZATION, FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_BUILDING, FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS, FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_HIST, FCLT_BUILDING_HIST, FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_1, FCLT_FLOOR, FCLT_FLOOR_HIST, FCLT_MAJOR_USE, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST, FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST, FCLT_ROOMS, and FCLT_ROOMS_HIST; fiscal period definitions (time month key, fiscal period, description) in FRC_FISCAL_PERIODS; fund‑center hierarchy levels in FUND_CENTER_HIERARCHY; HR faculty roster (MIT ID, name, degree, appointment type, job title, org unit) in HR_FACULTY_ROSTER; HR organization unit structures (org unit ID, title, level, department codes, hierarchy) in HR_ORG_UNIT and HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW; IAP subject categories, details, persons, sessions, and sponsors in IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL, IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON, IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION, and IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR; institution directory (name, address, country, category) in IR_INSTITUTION; library course‑instructor links (course, instructor, department, dates, unit) in LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR; library material status (code, description) in LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS; library reserve catalog entries (title, author, year, publisher, call number, ISBN) in LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG; library reserve material details linking catalog, subject offered, status, term, and subject in LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL; library subject offerings (term, master course number, subject title, department, faculty, enrollment) in LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED; department hierarchy (code, parent, names) in MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY, and MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY_LINKS; MIT holiday calendar (date, description, type) in MIT_HOLIDAY_CLOSING_CALENDAR; student directory (name, department, year, email, office) in MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY; Moira mailing list definitions and memberships in MOIRA_LIST, MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL, and MOIRA_LIST_OWNER; current OPA person records (identifiers, name, job, org unit, employment percent, sabbatical info) in OPA_PERSON_CURRENT; person authorization flags in PERSON_AUTH_AREA; profit‑center hierarchy (levels, names, DLC) in PROFIT_CENTER_GROUP; role‑to‑DLC mapping in ROLES_FIN_PA; simple employee records in SE_PERSON; SIS administrative department data (code, name, phone, clearing cost collector) in SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT; SIS course descriptions (course, description, department, term range, CIP code, degree‑granting flag) in SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION; SIS department definitions (code, name, school, budget code, degree‑granting flag) in SIS_DEPARTMENT; generic lookup tables in SIS_LOOKUP; SIS subject code mappings (course number, subject code, department) in SIS_SUBJECT_CODE; term address categories (code, description, living‑group type, validity dates) in SIS_TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY; space details (building, floor, room, square footage, component) in SPACE_DETAIL; floor names in SPACE_FLOOR; space supervisor usage statistics in SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE; space unit definitions (organization key, unit code, name, DLC) in SPACE_UNIT and SPACE_UNIT2; space usage types in SPACE_USAGE; student degree program definitions (degree code, description, type, term range, department, course level, double‑major flag) in STUDENT_DEGREE_PROGRAM; student department listings in STUDENT_DEPARTMENT; ethnic subgroup codes in STUDENT_ETHNIC_SUBGROUP; subject attribute catalog (code, type, short/long description) in SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE; enrollable subjects (term, subject ID, title, master ID, cluster list, offering department) in SUBJECT_ENROLLABLE; subject grouping metadata in SUBJECT_GROUPING; IAP schedule for subjects in SUBJECT_IAP_SCHEDULE; detailed subject offering records (subject key, term, course number, title, section types, department, faculty, meeting time/place, units, enrollment numbers) in SUBJECT_OFFERED; summarized subject offering data in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY; subject selector keys and clustering info in SUBJECT_SELECTOR; comprehensive subject summary statistics (units, enrollment counts, credit/listen metrics) in SUBJECT_SUMMARY; calendar day information (fiscal period, calendar date, day of week, academic term) in TIME_DAY; month‑level fiscal and academic periods in TIME_MONTH; quarter‑level fiscal periods and certification dates in TIME_QUARTER; TIP material linkage details (subject offered key, material key, status, term, ISBN, record count) in TIP_DETAIL; TIP material bibliographic data (ISBN, title, author, edition, publisher, year, prices, source) in TIP_MATERIAL; TIP material status codes in TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS; TIP subject offered summaries (term, course numbers, title, department, faculty, enrollment) in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED; top‑level internet domain definitions in TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN; warehouse user profiles (MIT ID, name, email, office, unit, title, appointment type) in WAREHOUSE_USERS; Canadian and US ZIP code lookups in ZIP_CANADA and ZIP_USA; and ZPM room load data (building room, component, floor, usage, space unit code, org unit, access level) in ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.

name: nova
description:
The nova database stores information about:
- AGENT_BUILDS (hypervisor, OS, architecture, version, URL, MD5 hash),
- AGGREGATE_HOSTS (host, aggregate ID),
- AGGREGATE_METADATA (aggregate ID, key, value),
- AGGREGATES (name, UUID),
- ALLOCATIONS (resource provider ID, consumer ID, resource class ID, used amount),
- BLOCK_DEVICE_MAPPING (device name, delete on termination, snapshot ID, volume ID, volume size, no‑device flag, connection info, instance UUID, source type, destination type, guest format, device type, disk bus, boot index, image ID),
- BW_USAGE_CACHE (start period, last refreshed, bandwidth in/out, MAC, UUID, last counters),
- CELLS (API URL, weight offset, weight scale, name, is parent, transport URL),
- CERTIFICATES (user ID, project ID, file name),
- COMPUTE_NODES (service ID, vCPUs, memory MB, local GB, used vCPUs/memory/GB, hypervisor type & version, CPU info, disk availability, free RAM/disk, workload, running VMs, hostname, host IP, supported instances, PCI stats, metrics, extra resources, stats, NUMA topology, host, allocation ratios, UUID),
- CONSOLE_POOLS (address, username, password, console type, public hostname, host, compute host),
- CONSOLES (instance name, password, port, pool ID, instance UUID),
- DNS_DOMAINS (domain, scope, availability zone, project ID),
- FIXED_IPS (address, network ID, allocated, leased, reserved, virtual interface ID, host, instance UUID),
- FLOATING_IPS (address, fixed IP ID, project ID, host, auto‑assigned, pool, interface),
- INSTANCE_ACTIONS (action, instance UUID, request ID, user ID, project ID, start/finish time, message),
- INSTANCE_ACTIONS_EVENTS (event, action ID, start/finish time, result, traceback, host, details),
- INSTANCE_EXTRA (instance UUID, NUMA topology, PCI requests, flavor, VCPU model, migration context),

- INSTANCE_TYPE_EXTRA_SPECS (instance type ID, key, value),

- INSTANCE_TYPES (name, memory MB, vCPUs, swap, VCPU weight, flavor ID, RX/TX factor, root GB, ephemeral GB, disabled, is public),

- INVENTORIES (resource provider ID, resource class ID, total, reserved, min/max unit, step size, allocation ratio),
- KEY_PAIRS (name, user ID, fingerprint, public key, type),
- MIGRATE_VERSION (repository ID, repository path, version),
- MIGRATIONS (source compute, destination compute, destination host, status, instance UUID, old/new instance type ID, source/destination node, migration type, hidden, memory total/processed/remaining, disk total/processed/remaining),
- NETWORKS (injected, CIDR, netmask, bridge, gateway, broadcast, DNS1, VLAN, VPN public/private address & port, DHCP start, project ID, host, IPv6 CIDR/gateway/netmask, label, multi‑host, DNS2, UUID, priority, RX/TX base, MTU, DHCP server, enable DHCP, share address),
- PCI_DEVICES (compute node ID, address, product ID, vendor ID, device type, device ID, label, status, extra info, instance UUID, request ID, NUMA node, parent address),
- PROJECT_USER_QUOTAS (user ID, project ID, resource, hard limit),
- PROVIDER_FW_RULES (protocol, from port, to port, CIDR),
- QUOTA_CLASSES (class name, resource, hard limit),
